name: Forgotten Pools
summary: The Forgotten Pools draw wildlife, Kolkar centaur, and the Horde into a contest for water in the northern Barrens. Northwest of the Crossroads, subterranean springs feed an oasis amid the dry savanna.

sections.title: An Oasis in the Wastes
sections.body: Fresh water gathers in the Forgotten Pools, where thick reeds, palm trees, and Laden Mushrooms grow beside the parched Barrens. Plainstriders, snapjaw turtles, and zhevras come to drink. Kolkar centaur keep a camp along the banks and guard the water from travelers, bringing them into conflict with Horde travelers from the Crossroads. Wildlife, Kolkar, and the Horde all contend for the oasis.

sections.title: Ecological Mysteries
sections.body: Deviate Fish thrive in the Forgotten Pools, one of the region’s rare surface waters where they can be found. Their presence hints at deeper ties to the strange transformative energies altering the Barrens’ water table. Horde naturalists and scouts watch the waters and unusual fungi along the banks, wary of what may be seeping into the soil.

faq.q: Where are the Forgotten Pools located?
faq.answer: The Forgotten Pools lie in the northern Barrens, directly northwest of the Crossroads and just north of the road that branches west toward the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why are the Kolkar centaur here?
faq.answer: Water sustains life in the arid Barrens, so the Kolkar aggressively claim every oasis they can reach. They sustain their warbands and deny vital resources to traveling Horde caravans and nearby settlements.

faq.q: What makes the fish and plants here unusual?
faq.answer: The Forgotten Pools are one of the few places above ground where Deviate Fish thrive, and unusual Laden Mushrooms grow along the banks. These mutations point to subterranean disturbances influencing the Barrens’ underground aquifers.

faq.q: Did Thrall pass through this oasis?
faq.answer: No record says which oases Thrall’s Horde rested at during its long march across the Barrens, so whether the Forgotten Pools was among them is unknown.

angles.text: Holding the Forgotten Pools helps secure the trade routes out of the Crossroads and keep the Kolkar from choking the Horde’s western supply lines.
The rapid growth of mutated vegetation and Deviate Fish around the Forgotten Pools gives Cenarion researchers evidence as they investigate unnatural shifts across the Barrens.
